ns2:course.label: Micro and Nanolithography
ns2:course.description: A comprehensive foundation in the broad field of micro and nanolithography, including the science of optical imaging, photochemistry, and materials issues; technological developments including state-of-the-art commercial lithography systems; applications of micro and nanolithography to diverse fields, including semiconductor devices, displays, flexible electronics, microelectromechanical systems, and biotechnology. Prerequisite: One of ECE 444, ECE 460, MSE 462, NPRE 429, PHYS 402.
